evidence: X-ray Photoelectron Spectroscopy (XPS), Atomic Force Microscopy (AFM), X-ray Diffraction (XRD), Scanning Electron Microscopy (SEM), Energy-Dispersive X-ray Spectroscopy (EDS), Ellipsometry, X-ray Reflectivity (XRR), Four-point probe, Hall Effect, and C-V measurement were used to analyze the ALD process and the resulting films.
